column1: # MANIFEST (added cycle 219, PREREG219 Part B): scope and input sha256 of each zero-hit result file in this folder. The result files themselves stay frozen.
# input_sha256 = sha256 of the 97-letter string without newline. K4 = data/k4.txt; null0 = random.Random(209230).shuffle(K4).
